latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of music-ai: generate music-synced videos from your audio files

- Upload audio files (MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC up to 200MB) and quickly generate AI-driven music videos with beat-synced visuals.
- Automatic cloud setup: handles session, token, and connection seamlessly; notifies when ready.
- Supports export to 1080p MP4 and other formats; check credits and job status.
- Upload, describe your idea, refine edits, and download the result—all in 1-2 minutes.
- Ideal for musicians and creators wanting professional-looking videos without editing software or a videographer.
